name: Apple Basket Catch

meta.name: Apple Basket Catch
meta.tagline: Track falling apples and catch them before they hit the ground.
meta.description: Move a basket left and right to catch falling apples. Apples speed up, arrive more often, and become harder to catch as the episode progresses. Catch enough apples to win, but three misses end the game.

rewardTerms.description: Accumulated closeness of the basket to the active apple.
Small reward for each step survived.
Number of apples that reached the ground uncaught.

presets.name: aggressive
presets.description: Prioritize catching as many apples as possible.

presets.name: survivalist
presets.description: Value careful positioning and lasting longer.

human.hint: Use the left and right arrow keys to move the basket under the apple.
